subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit soft-steer lifecycle that interrupts or pauses active generation/tool work, injects user input, and resumes with partial context, or keep default steering model-boundary based?
rationale: The choice affects shared runtime semantics, channel-visible behavior, Codex/native runtime integration, and the compatibility boundary between steer, followup, collect, and interrupt modes.

options.title: Design soft-steer explicitly
options.body: Keep this issue open as the tracker and require a maintainer-sponsored design before landing runtime changes.

options.title: Keep Boundary Steering
options.body: Keep `steer` as the supported default model-boundary behavior and route only ordinary delivery gaps through the narrower active-run steering issue.

options.title: Land only the narrow subset
options.body: Treat active non-streaming queue injection as the only supported improvement and track true pause/resume separately.

recommendation.title: Design soft-steer explicitly
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the tracker and require a maintainer-sponsored design before landing runtime changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the most recent active-run steering changes that define the current partial implementation boundary.
